userIntent: Add viewer panes: a split-tree pane whose content is a beautifully rendered markdown file (headings, nested+task lists, tables, syntax-highlighted code, blockquotes, links, images, hr, inline formatting), a text/code file, or a website — via WKWebView with fully bundled offline assets. CLI: +new-window/+split --view=<path-or-url>. In-app: File→Open on .md. Live reload. Sensible +list/+read/+send-keys/+close/persistence behavior. View-only.

loop: 1. On session start: read THIS file fully, then docs/design/viewer-panes.md fully. Do not re-explore the codebase for facts already recorded there — the file:line maps come from a thorough 2026-07-17 sweep.
2. Pick the first task with status=pending whose dependsOn are all done. Set it to in_progress (edit this file) before starting work.
3. Do the task. Keep it small; if it balloons, split it into sub-tasks in this file and finish only the first.
4. Verify per the task's acceptance. Build must pass. For user-facing changes, kill + relaunch the DEBUG app from this worktree and verify live.

5. Commit on this branch: git add -A && git commit with a descriptive message ending in the Claude Co-Authored-By trailer. Record SHA + outcome + surprises in the task's notes, set status=done (or blocked with reason).
6. Add newly-discovered follow-up tasks to the tasks array (small, ordered).

7. If the just-finished task has resetAfter=true AND tasks remain: invoke the Skill tool with skill='dzearing-skills:reset-context' and args='Read /Users/dzearing/git/ghoztty-markdown-preview/docs/design/viewer-panes-tasks.json and follow its protocol: execute pending tasks until the next resetAfter boundary, then reset context again.' Otherwise continue to the next task in THIS session.
8. If ALL tasks are done (or only blocked ones remain): do NOT reset. Write a final summary: what shipped, E2E results (screenshots), what is blocked and why.
rules: NEVER touch /Applications/Ghoztty.app in any way — it is the user's primary terminal. Debug app only: zig-out/Ghoztty-Debug.app (bundle id com.dzearing.ghoztty.debug, socket ghostty-debug-<uid>.sock).
All bundle identifiers stay in com.dzearing.ghoztty.* — NEVER com.mitchellh.*.
Use /usr/bin/log (never bare `log` — zsh builtin shadows it).

Stale-instance trap: after rebuilding, kill any running debug instance and relaunch from THIS worktree before trusting live behavior (verify process start time > binary mtime). Killing DEBUG instances is safe unless this effort created live test windows the user is using.
NEVER 'tell process "ghoztty"' by NAME in System Events — the RELEASE app shares the process name. Scope by pid or use 'tell application id "com.dzearing.ghoztty.debug"'.
NEVER run +new-remote-window unattended: a failed dial pops a modal alert that wedges ALL CLI IPC.
GUI driving + screenshots are permitted on this machine (Accessibility/Screen Recording granted).
Zero network for the markdown/text viewer path — all assets bundled; only the website mode may touch the network.
If the user interrupts with new instructions, encode them as tasks in this file instead of drifting.

environment.notes: Official zig 0.15.2 binary cannot link on this macOS 26.4 box; the brew zig@0.15 bottle works (memory: ghoztty-macos26-zig-toolchain).

decisions: Pane-based viewers in the split tree; NOT a standalone preview window type (user rejected that).
Engine: WKWebView + bundled markdown-it/highlight.js/github-markdown-css, fully offline for files. Approved.

Leaf refactor: concrete PaneView wrapper (enum content: terminal|viewer), tree → SplitTree<PaneView>. Approved 2026-07-17 over protocol/existential leaf (SplitTree Codable decodes one concrete ViewType).
CLI: extend +new-window/+split with --view=<path-or-url>; mutually exclusive with --command/-e; relative paths resolved CLI-side against --working-directory else caller cwd.
+read/+send-keys/+set-banner/+set-state on a viewer → clean IPC error, exit 1. Close never confirms for viewers.

Persistence: manifest leaves gain kind+viewerLocation, viewers count always-restorable/never probed; AppKit restore rides PaneView.Codable with infallible viewer decode (missing file → in-page error).
File→Open reroutes only the .md family to a viewer window; other extensions keep today's terminal behavior. Clickable .md paths in terminal output: deferred.
Context plan: /reset-context at resetAfter boundaries (after T02 and T08).

tasks.notes: 2026-07-17: done, E2E verified across TWO quit/relaunch cycles. Leaf gains kind ('viewer') + viewerLocation + isViewer (optional fields — pre-viewer manifests decode unchanged); syncEntry emits them; hasMissingSessionIDs skips viewers (no 30s capture spin); probeSessions already skips nil-sid leaves; drop policy already safe (nil sid = .unknown, never counts dead — viewer leaves therefore always-restorable); makeSessionLayoutRoot branches isViewer -> PaneView(viewer:) re-opening the location; registerRestoredViewerPane + registeredPaneName(forViewerPane:) keep t09view addressable after restore (verified: +read t09view returns the clean viewer error = name resolved to live pane). Restored window shows target t09 in +list (registerRestoredRemoteWindow now adopts the name as controller.windowName — improves ALL restored windows). NOTE: viewer-ONLY windows never register in the manifest (no agent session -> no remoteConnection hook) — they persist via the AppKit path (T10), by design. Agent-unreachable keeps all entries for next launch (existing policy, viewers included).

tasks.goal: With session-persistence=off and window-save-state default, a mixed window restores via NSWindowRestoration; viewer decode is infallible (missing file → in-page error).

tasks.notes: 2026-07-17: done. No new code needed beyond PaneView.Codable (T01) — verified it end-to-end. IMPORTANT ENV FACT: modern macOS defaults NSQuitAlwaysKeepsWindows=NO ('close windows when quitting'), so AppKit window restoration does NOT run on plain quit on this box; tested by scoping `defaults write com.dzearing.ghoztty.debug NSQuitAlwaysKeepsWindows -bool true` (per-app; domain vanished again after test, nothing to clean). With it: two viewer-only windows restored across quit/relaunch — torture.md rendered, and a window whose file was DELETED between quit and relaunch restored showing the in-page 'Cannot read file' card (infallible viewer decode confirmed; no window loss, no wedge). Viewer-only windows use the AppKit path even with session-persistence=on (no agent session). NOT covered: mixed terminal+viewer AppKit tree (needs persistence=off; the terminal leaf legacy/new Codable paths are exercised by unit inspection only) — acceptable: manifest path owns mixed trees on this config. AppKit-restored windows don't keep IPC names/targets (pre-existing: AppKit state has no registry info).
